units.source_text: 却说惟光大夫奉命窥探邻家情状，大有收获，特来报告。

en.t: Meanwhile, the gentleman Koremitsu had gone as ordered to spy on the neighboring house, and now came to report that he had learned a great deal.

units.source_text: 他说：“那家的女主人是何等样人，竟不可知。

en.t: He said, "It is impossible to tell what sort of person the mistress of that house really is.

units.source_text: 我看此人态度十分隐秘，绝不让人知道来历。

en.t: From what I can see, she is extremely secretive and will not let anyone know her background.

units.source_text: 但闻生活寂寞无聊，因此迁居到这向南开吊窗的陋屋里来。

en.t: I have only heard that her life was lonely and dull, and that this is why she moved into this shabby house with the south-facing hanging shutters.

units.source_text: 每逢大街上车轮声响，青年侍女们便出来窥看。

en.t: Whenever carriage wheels sound on the main street, the young serving women come out to peep.

units.source_text: 有一个主妇模样的女子，有时也悄悄地跟着出来。

en.t: There is one woman who looks like the mistress of the house, and sometimes she quietly follows them out too.

units.source_text: 隐约望去，此人容颜十分俊俏。

en.t: Even seen only indistinctly, she has a very pretty face.

units.source_text: 有一日，一辆车子在大街上开路喝道而来。

en.t: One day, a carriage came along the main street with attendants calling out to clear the way.

units.source_text: 一个女童窥见了，连忙走进屋子里叫道：‘右近大姐！

en.t: A little girl caught sight of it, hurried into the house, and cried, 'Lady Ukon!

units.source_text: 快出来看，中将大人从这里经过呢！’

en.t: Come out quickly and look, Lord Chujo is passing by here!'

units.source_text: 就有一个身份相当的侍女走出来，向她摇手，说道：‘静些儿！’

en.t: Then a serving woman of some standing came out, waved her hand at the girl, and said, 'Be quiet!'

units.source_text: 又说：‘你怎么知道是中将大人呢？

en.t: Then she added, 'How do you know it is Lord Chujo?

units.source_text: 让我来看看。’便要走过来窥看。

en.t: Let me have a look.' With that, she was about to come over and peep for herself.

units.source_text: 通这屋子的路上有一道板桥。

en.t: On the path leading to this house there was a plank bridge.

units.source_text: 这侍女急急忙忙地赶出来，衣裾被板桥绊住，跌了一跤，几乎翻落桥下。

en.t: The serving woman rushed out in a hurry, but her hem caught on the plank bridge, and she stumbled, nearly tumbling down beneath it.

units.source_text: 她骂道：‘该死的葛城神仙[\[13\]](#part1333.html#m13)！

en.t: She cursed, 'Damn that god of Katsuragi[\[13\]](#part1333.html#m13)!

units.source_text: 架的桥多危险！’窥看的兴致就消减了。

en.t: What a dangerous bridge he built!' And her eagerness to peep was dampened.

units.source_text: 车子里那位头中将[\[14\]](#part1333.html#m14)身穿便服，带着几个随从。

en.t: The To no Chujo[\[14\]](#part1333.html#m14) inside the carriage was dressed informally and had several attendants with him.

units.source_text: 那侍女便指着这些人说，这是谁，那是谁。

en.t: The serving woman pointed at the men and said who this one was and who that one was.

units.source_text: 她说出来的正是头中将的随从和侍童的名字。”

en.t: The names she gave were indeed those of To no Chujo's attendants and page boys."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“车子里的人确是头中将么？”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "Was the person in the carriage truly To no Chujo?"

units.source_text: 他心中想：“那么，这女子莫非就是那天晚上头中将说他恋恋不舍的那个常夏么？”

en.t: In his heart he thought, "Then could this woman be that Tokonatsu whom To no Chujo said the other night he could not forget?"

units.source_text: 惟光看见公子意欲知道得更详细些，又报告道：“不瞒您说：

en.t: Seeing that the prince wished to know more details, Koremitsu reported further, "To tell you the truth,

units.source_text: 我已搭上了一个侍女，亲昵得很；因此他家情况我全都知道了。

en.t: I have already struck up a very intimate acquaintance with one of the serving women, and so I know everything about that household.

units.source_text: 其中有一个年轻女子，装作侍女同伴模样，说话也用并辈口气，其实是女主人呢。

en.t: Among them is a young woman who pretends to be one of the serving women's companions and even speaks as though she were their equal, but in fact she is the mistress.

units.source_text: 我假装不知，在他家进进出出。

en.t: I pretend not to know and go in and out of the house.

units.source_text: 那些女人都严守秘密。

en.t: All those women keep the secret very strictly.

units.source_text: 可是有几个女童，有时不小心，对她称呼时不免露出口风来。

en.t: But a few of the little girls sometimes grow careless, and when they address her they cannot help letting something slip.

units.source_text: 那时她们就巧言掩饰，硬装作这里并无主人的样子。”

en.t: Then the others cover it up with clever words and force themselves to act as if there were no mistress there at all."

units.source_text: 说着笑起来。

en.t: As he said this, he began to laugh.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“几时我去探望奶妈，乘便让我也窥探一下吧。”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "When I go to visit my nurse one day, let me take the opportunity to have a look too."

units.source_text: 他心中想：“虽说是暂住，但看家中排场，正是左马头所看不起的下等女子吧。

en.t: In his heart he thought, "It may only be a temporary lodging, but judging from the household's appearance, she must be just the sort of lower-ranking woman that the Captain of the Left Horse Guards despises.

units.source_text: 然而这等级中也许有意想不到的乐趣呢。”

en.t: Still, among women of this rank there may be unexpected pleasures."

units.source_text: 惟光一向丝毫不肯违背主人的意愿；加之自己又是一个不放过一切机会的好色者，便用尽心计，东奔西走，终于教源氏公子和这家的女主人幽会了。

en.t: Koremitsu never wished to go against his master's desires in the slightest, and being himself a man of amorous habits who missed no opportunity, he used every scheme, rushed here and there, and at last arranged a secret meeting between Prince Genji and the mistress of the house.

units.source_text: 其间经过，不免琐屑，照例省略了。

en.t: The details of how this came about are inevitably trivial, and as usual they have been omitted.
